title: Qi Transfer
text:
Qi Transfer channels your reserve into spiritual plants and other receptive targets. Aim at the target and hold the skill.


Each successful pulse transfers one Qi; training increases pulse frequency, reduces stamina overhead and extends reach.


Plants require conversion costs of 100 Qi at T1, 1,000 at T2 and 10,000 at T3 for each transferred Qi, plus stamina overhead.
